{{Quote|There you are, my little beauty!|Boakie to R2-D2|<ref name="Shadows of Mindor" />}}
'''Boakie''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] who was part of [[Aeona Cantor]]'s group that stood against [[Lord/Legends|Lord]] [[Cronal|Shadowspawn's]] rule on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Mindor/Legends|Mindor]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

==Biography==
In [[5 ABY/Legends|5 ABY]], Boakie went with [[Tripp (Mindor)|Tripp]] and a group of followers under the command of Aeona Cantor to help her free Nick Rostu from the power of warlord Shadowspawn. Upon arriving to Mindor, he found [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]] when the droid was separated from [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]]. When Boakie grabbed Artoo however, he received an electrical shock that left him twitching helplessly on the ground.<ref name="Shadows of Mindor" />

{{Char-stub}}

==Personality and traits==
Based on the auditory sensors recorded by Artoo, Boakie was said to have an [[Inner Rim/Legends|Inner Rim]] accent when speaking [[Galactic Basic Standard/Legends|Basic]].<ref name="Shadows of Mindor" />
